description: This file defines the SMTPCredentialsData class, which encapsulates SMTP server credentials such as username, password, host, port, TLS usage, and sender email & name for email configuration within the Fineract project.

classes.name: SMTPCredentialsData
classes.description: A data class holding SMTP server credentials and sender information, with chainable setters, via Lombok annotations.

methods.name: getFromEmail
methods.description: Returns the fromEmail if set; otherwise defaults to username.

methods.name: getFromName
methods.description: Returns the fromName if set; otherwise defaults to username.
